ask_function_name.description: Ask function name (the live test invokes it directly with the same event API Gateway sends).

ask_url.description: POST URL, resolvable only inside the VPC (private DNS on the execute-api endpoint).

inference_profile_arn.description: Application inference profile the function calls; its tags drive cost allocation.

vpc_id.description: Private VPC that holds the function and the endpoints.

description.constant_value: Interface endpoints: HTTPS from inside the VPC
Ask function: HTTPS to the VPC endpoints only
HTTPS to the Bedrock interface endpoints
HTTPS from the VPC (the function, and staff clients routed into the VPC)

alarm_topic_arn.description: SNS topic for alarms and the budget (data stack output alerts_topic_arn).

answer_model_id.description: Model that writes the answers (ADR 0007). Cross-Region inference profiles start with "us.".

availability_zone_ids.description: Two zone IDs (not names, which differ per account) where the Bedrock endpoint services are offered.

guardrail_version.description: Published guardrail version to enforce. DRAFT is refused: the function must run a reviewed version.

kb_kms_key_arn.description: KMS key of the knowledge-base stack (the guardrail is encrypted with it).

log_retention_days.description: Days to keep function, API and flow logs.

manage_api_gateway_account.description: Set the account-level API Gateway CloudWatch role (needed once per account and Region for API logs).

monthly_budget_usd.description: Monthly cost budget for resources tagged project = name. Alerts at 80 percent forecast and 100 percent actual.

name.description: Name prefix for every resource (lower case, digits and hyphens).

region.description: AWS Region for every stack in this repository.

reserved_concurrency.description: Upper bound on concurrent answers, which also bounds the Bedrock spend rate.

retrieval.description: Context selection for the ask function (see src/harbor_rag/prompt.py and docs/runbook.md).

vpc_cidr.description: CIDR of the private VPC that holds the function and the interface endpoints.
